question: Should OpenClaw support per-agent web-search/tool credentials as `agents.list[].tools.web`, as a generic per-agent plugin config override, or through a broader per-agent credential/env contract?
rationale: All plausible fixes add security-sensitive config surface and affect plugin/provider ownership, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent public contract.

options.title: Generic plugin/tool config override
options.body: Create a single per-agent override contract that can cover plugin-owned web-search credentials and future tool settings without special-casing one provider family.

options.title: Narrow web-search-only override
options.body: Add only `agents.list[].tools.web.search` support, which is smaller but risks another parallel credential path beside plugin config.

options.title: Defer to per-agent env/credential isolation
options.body: Keep tool config global and solve agent-specific credentials through a broader env or SecretRef scoping design.

recommendation.title: Generic plugin/tool config override
recommendation.body: Create a single per-agent override contract that can cover plugin-owned web-search credentials and future tool settings without special-casing one provider family.

likelyOwner.reason: Current schema blame and config-surface work make this the best available routing candidate for the contract decision.
